rune4_v0.1.0.description: # Setup Guide ## Necessary Software: [Archipelago Latest Release](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest) [quick bms](https://aluigi.altervista.org/quickbms.htm) RF4S APworld `rune4.apworld` ## Setup steps: - Create a folder named "Archipelago" in your Rune Factory 4 Special install directory. Extract Quickbms somewhere on your machine where it won't get moved. Personally, I put it into my install directory as well. It should look something like the picture below. - Install the RF4S AP world (This can be done by simply double clicking the apworld wherever you downloaded it to. If it asks for a program to open it with, choose the Archipelago launcher.) - Open your AP launcher and select "Generate Template files", which will make your RF4S Template and open your template folder. - Set up your yaml, and when done, place it into your "players" folder, then generate your game (or send the yaml to the person that will be hosting if you'll be playing a multiworld.) - Generate your game. - In the output zip from generation, there will be a save marked with your chosen player name. Place that save into the Archipelago folder we made in your install directory. If you have Trupin hints enabled, also place your hints.json file in the same Rune Factory 4 Special\Archipelago folder as well. - Run the RF4S Client from the AP launcher. This will prompt you for the paths to your install folder, the BMS folder (which if you followed this guide is probably inside of your install folder), and your RF4S saves folder, which can usually be found at C:\Users(your username here)\AppData\Roaming\Rune Factory 4 Special - Once given the right paths, the client will automatically generate your save, back up the save it replaces, and open RF4S. From there, you need only connect to your server and play the game. # Randomizations ## Goals - Ethelberd - Rune Prana - Shipment Percentage - Nationalize Baths (untested) - Rune Hunt - Homeowner (untested) - Marriage (Shipping white stone, untested) - Custom (Any specific location as a goal) Eliza goal are planned but unimplemented ## Items - Area Access items - Crafting Licenses - Special Quality of Life items - Progressive Equipment ## Locations - Shipments - Crops (normal/large/gold) - Drops - Crafts - Forge - Crafting Table - Dishes - Potions - Minerals - Groceries - Spells - Chests - Monster Taming - Friendship Levels - Outfit Purchases ## Options - Deathlink - Mistress Trupin Hints - Starting Weapon - Music/Sound Effect Randomization - Monster Randomization (Sometimes unstable) - Changing Character Appearance - Shuffle Spell Elements ## Quality of Life - Exp/Skill Exp multipliers - Drop Rate Boosting - No Jones Fee - Show Enemy HP/Level ## Planned Features - Requestsanity ## Credits ### Coding - Happyhappyism ### Spreadsheet Mapping - Caidyrn - Tilemon - Prelude ### Testing - Caidyrn - Noa - Maki - Prelude

rune4_v0.2.0.description:
## Functionality Updates
- No longer requires quickbms to function, crc checksum is now calculated by the apworld itself

## New Features
### Sanities
- Requestsanity
- Barriersanity
- Boxsanity
- Searchsanity

## Changes
- Chestsanity is now moved to an option
- Eliza Goal is now selectable
- Added [poptracker](https://github.com/rdpeake/rune4-poptracker) link to manifest
- Gloves location now split to differentiate between the accessory and weapon
- Emery Flower and great emery flower now bumped up to tier 11 from 10
- Shmooly liked item changed from Lumber to Clippers

## Fixes
- Fixed a chest in Sechs Territory not spawning (maybe)
- Command Line arguments are now accepted
- Added addtional slot data 
- Added mapid bounce packet for the [poptracker](https://github.com/rdpeake/rune4-poptracker)
- Save pathing no longer breaks when a . exists in the path

## Notes
This version is mostly untested and maybe unstable but released for the need for more testing

rune4_v0.3.0.description:
### Notes
Pretty massive update this time with a lot of help from [arryndoestech](https://github.com/arryndoestech) who is working on some pretty cool mod tools for the game and a [poptracker pack](https://github.com/rdpeake/rune4-poptracker) made by [rdpeake](https://github.com/rdpeake)

## New Features
- Completely reworked the Save/Load system so that it no longer touches your vanilla saves
- Setup has been completely reworked to be simplier reduced down to a prompt to move a single file
- Boxsanity
- Barriersanity
- Requestsanity (Some locations still need testing and fixing)

## Fixes
- Added a patch to fix a crash when reloading to the main menu
- Fixed an issue where monster moveset and ai randomization slot data was swapped
- Fixed a backwards compatibility issue with slot data
- Fixed an issue where bad file names would cause the client not to connect
- Fixed a bug where craft level ups weren't received while offline
- Yokmir Forest D1 Chest tier was reduced from 10 to 0
- Added two missing chest locations
- Fixed some bugged logic for recipe bread shipments and a few chests

## Changes
- Added tiering checks for chest, barrier and box locations
- Added tabs to the client
 - Added seed info tab to display seed information upon connecting


## Other
- Added slot data for shipsanities
- Hopefully sped up the client loop a bit, locations get checked less frequently though
rune4_v0.3.0.title: Rune Factory 4 Archipelago Version 0.3.0
